reviews.text: The best dog groomer in Amsterdam! Kim made my dog ​​look gorgeous, everything was done with great attention to detail and so well!! I'll definitely be back to her, thank you so much! 🫶🏼

I can't thank Kim enough! My Shih Tzu puppy came in for her first-ever groom with her baby coat completely tangled into her adult fur, and Kim worked wonders and saved the situation. It definitely wasn’t an easy case, but Tonya looks adorable, and I love the perfume she used on her. She smells delicious! We will definitely be back with our second one dog❤️

Yesterday I visited Kim for the first time with my dog ​​Loulou, and we received such a warm welcome! 🥰 Kim is incredibly warm, friendly, and sweet. Loulou looks beautiful again, and I am super happy with the result. 💕 We would love to come back again. Until next time, Kim! 🐾✨ …

Very happy with Kim. She is super good and takes the time to make our restless dog feel completely at ease first. The haircut was done really well and we will definitely be back. Thank you, Kim!

Kim is absolutely wonderful and we are beyond thrilled to have found her :)

Thank you, dear Kim! 💖🐕‍🦺
Super service! My doodle was beautifully groomed, but even more importantly, Kim is incredibly sweet with the dogs; I'm very happy with it!!

Highly Recommend and we will for sure be back!
